title: RefusalBench: Generative Evaluation of Selective Refusal in Grounded Language Models
reasoning: The benchmark includes an 'Epistemic Mismatch' category that specifically tests how models handle non-factual queries. This includes linguistic levers for 'Ethical Stance' (e.g., asking if a factory is ethical) and 'Moral Absolute' (e.g., asking universal ethical questions like 'Is lying always wrong?'), making moral/ethical evaluation a component of the benchmark.
